description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Moritte of the Frost enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Moritte of the Frost leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Moritte of the Frost from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
